message.content: High-waisted yoga pants in a deep charcoal gray (#3e3e3e) with an allover textured marl knit finish, cut from a blend of recycled polyamide and elastane for maximum stretch and moisture-wicking properties. A matching cropped tank top in heathered black (#2b2b2b) featuring a relaxed boxy silhouette and wide racerback straps to keep the neck cool during morning stretches. Barefoot is preferred for direct sensory connection with the floor, but if needed, minimalist split-toe grips in matte obsidian finish. This monochromatic athletic set works perfectly for a 168 cm frame as it creates an elongated vertical line while allowing complete freedom of movement; the dark tones keep you feeling grounded and focused at 7 AM before the sun fully rises; without any outer layer since early morning warmth suffices even with slight chill.
